chemistry-killer-03.material: 14 g oo nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) iyo 4 g oo hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) ayaa weel la geliyay oo si buuxda loo falgaliyay si loo sameeyo ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Falgalku waa $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, culeysyada atomiga waa H=1, N=14, falgalkuna wuu socdaa ilaa mid ka mid ah walxaha falgala dhammaado. Waa maxay, si isku xigta, cufka (g) ee $\mathrm{NH_3}$ ee la sameeyay kadib falgalka iyo mugga dhammaan gaasaska weelka ku jira kadib falgalka oo loo beddelay xaaladda caadiga ah (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: 14 g oo nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) iyo 4 g oo hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) ayaa weel la geliyay oo si buuxda loo falgaliyay si loo sameeyo ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Falgalku waa $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, culeysyada atomiga waa H=1, N=14, falgalkuna wuu socdaa ilaa mid ka mid ah walxaha falgala dhammaado. Waa maxay, si isku xigta, cufka (g) ee $\mathrm{NH_3}$ ee la sameeyay kadib falgalka iyo mugga dhammaan gaasaska weelka ku jira kadib falgalka oo loo beddelay xaaladda caadiga ah (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Mole. $\mathrm{N_2}$ 14 g ÷ 28 g/mol = 0.5 mol, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 4 g ÷ 2 g/mol = 2 mol.
Tallaabo 2: Isbarbar dhig qiimaha lagu qaybiyay coefficients-ka. $\mathrm{N_2}$: 0.5/1 = 0.5, $\mathrm{H_2}$: 2/3 ≈ 0.67. $\mathrm{N_2}$ oo leh qiimaha yar ayaa ah walaxda xaddidaysa.
Tallaabo 3: Haddii $\mathrm{N_2}$ 0.5 mol dhammaantiis falgasho, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 1.5 mol ayaa la isticmaalaa, $\mathrm{NH_3}$ 1.0 mol ayaa la sameeyaa. Cufka = 1.0 × 17 = 17 g. $\mathrm{H_2}$ hadhay = 2 − 1.5 = 0.5 mol.
Tallaabo 4: Wadarta mole-ka gaaska kadib falgalka = 1.0 + 0.5 = 1.5 mol → mugga STP = 1.5 × 22.4 = 33.6 L.
Jawaab: 17 g, 33.6 L (c). (Jawaabaha khaldan: 22.4 L waxay iska indho tirtay H2 hadhay, 34 g waxay ku dhufatay coefficient 2 mole-ka NH3 oo ku qaldantay mole-ka N2·H2, 8.5 g waxay si qalad ah u arkday N2 : NH3 = 1 : 1.)
